english.title: Cause or permit vehicle / railway vehicle to be brought onto a quay etc after written objection - Port of Liverpool
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was in charge of a

(A)_[vehicle,]_
(B)_[railway vehicle,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..) and caused or permitted it to

(C)_[be brought onto]_
(D)_[remain on]_

a quay or jetty, namely **(..SPECIFY QUAY OR JETTY..), when notice in writing objecting to its presence or future presence had been given to you or the owner
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 12(a) and 39(a) of the Port of Liverpool General Byelaws 2021.
